questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Please explain: *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: At jeg kunne rejse dertil med tog eller bus. At det var forholdsvist både nemt og affordable at finde et sted at bo.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Semi nemt, men fik mange gentagende mails, så informationen druknede lidt i mængden.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde orienteringsuge på mit fakultet, hvilket var meget hjælpsomt.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Jeg brugte facebook. Tips: vær i god tid!

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det er worth it at finde sig eget, selvom det er dyrere og mere besværligt.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Jeg blev taget meget i hånden: Alt skete under orienteringsuge i et planlagt program, så skulle vitterligt bare følge med.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Vi kunne både benytte den internationale koordinator + studerende på universitetet, der agerede 'tutorer'-

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Det gik. Men man skal sidde klar, når tilmelding til fagene åbner.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Alt skal nok gå op, selvom det kan virke uoverskueligt og man måske ønsker at være i bedre tid med de praktiske ting end universiteterne tillader.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Niveauet var fint. Da jeg havde seks forskellige fag med få ECTS point, var der ikke plads til lige så meget fordybelse som derhjemme. Dette afspejlede også eksamensformen.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Det lader til, at det er meget op til den enkelte underviser at organisere sine kurser, hvilket også betød, at der var ret stor indbyrdes forskel i de kurser, jeg tog. Nogle var mere diskussionspræget, end jeg er vant til - med diskussioner der ofte var mere anekdotiske end akademiske.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Seminar of Contemporary Art
Historical Literature and Narrative
Feminism and Environmental Movements
Contemporary Theories of Masculinities
Introduction to Anthropology of Arts
Medieval Origins of Literature Written By and For Women

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Medieval Origins of Literature Written By and For Women. Sødeste underviser og skønne facts of middelalderen. Prag er en meget medieval city, så hvis man på nogen som helst måde interesserer sig en smule for det, så tag et middelalderkursus!

Feminism and Environmental Movements. God underviser, konkret pensum, god blanding af diskussioner og 'forelæsning'.

Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Ingen

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Det er dyrt at gå til træning! Eller i svømmehallen.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der var helt sikkert mange ting, men jeg opsøgte det ikke.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I Prag er der mange forskellige venues man kan holde øje med - der er både koncerter, teater, workshops osv. Man skal helt sikkert gå en masse i biografen! De har mange forskellige art house biografer, der er virkelig hyggelige - og derudover er billetten billig.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Det er nemt, billigt og hurtigt at tage en flixbus til fx Wien eller Leipzig. Derudover er der mange flotte steder at vandre i Tjekkiet. Hvis man er til goth ting, skal man helt klart tjekke knoglekirken ud i Kutna Hora.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt, kulturen er ikke så anderledes.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Nej desværre mødte jeg ikke mange tjekkere.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Der var ikke rigtig nogle.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Man lifestyler ret meget i Prag. Der er meget caféliv, folk sidder til ud på aften på fortovscafeer og hygger.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Selvom hele processen med at vælge fag kan virke så besværlig og kafkask, skal det hele nok gå op! 
2. Køb månedlige transportkort - det er totalt worth it
3. Der er meget at lave i Prag, men der er ingen grund til at stresse sig selv.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nej

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At have mere tid end derhjemme til at gøre, hvad man vil! At blive bedre til engelsk!

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At snakke engelsk.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
